<thought>Retrieve polymorph data for up to 40 nitride compositions using the provided batch tool with the specified energy and count limits, then consolidate, prepare a tabular dataset, train and evaluate the XGBoost model, and finally save the evaluation results as JSON.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "AlN", "GaN", "InN", "BN", "Si3N4", "TiN", "ZrN", "HfN", "CrN", "MoN",
        "VN", "NbN", "TaN", "ScN", "YN", "Mg3N2", "Ca3N2", "Sr3N2", "Ba3N2",
        "Li3N", "Na3N", "K3N", "Be3N2", "Cd3N2", "Zn3N2", "FeN", "CoN", "NiN",
        "CuN", "AgN", "AuN", "PbN", "SnN", "BiN", "SbN", "AsN", "P3N5", "SiN",
        "GeN", "Sn3N4"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/workdir/5/ml_nitrides_trial_12"
}</action_input>
